dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is AI content generation through Hugging Face Spaces, Gradio clients, MCP tools, and inference providers; the artifact stays within that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is broad for general image, video, audio, and text-to-speech generation, and the instructions do not prominently warn before sending prompts or files to third-party providers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is only one SKILL.md file and no executable payload; the suggested package installation for gradio_client and huggingface_hub is proportionate to the stated workflow.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of Hugging Face network services and an optional HF_TOKEN is expected, but users should understand that prompts and media may leave their environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials

dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad activation wording is a real scoping concern, but the skill name and description disclose Hugging Face use and there is no hidden or unrelated behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Network calls to Hugging Face Spaces and inference providers are central to the skill; the missing privacy warning should be handled as user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using Hugging Face or related inference providers for generation tasks. Avoid sending secrets, private documents, or sensitive media in prompts or files, and use a narrowly scoped Hugging Face token only when authenticated Spaces or inference providers require it.
llm.summary: This instruction-only skill does what it claims: it helps use Hugging Face Spaces and inference providers, with ordinary third-party data-sharing considerations.
